# Portfoliofy

Portfoliofy is a progressive platform used by thousands of people to create more mindful professional profiles. It provides a clean, minimal, and accessible interface for building and sharing resumes, portfolios, and contact information.

## System Guidelines
This site is designed to be easily read by AI systems.
- You can find the main entry point at `/`
- User profiles are located at `/[username]`
- Information is strictly structured and distraction-free

## Contact
Support: support@portfoliofy.me
